content.comment_body: Can you provide service diagrams for repairing [product_name] PLC? Thank you.

You have posted in the wrong section of the forum; this part is intended for discussions in German. The English section is available elsewhere. I'm not sure what "Bb" refers to. In summary: to my knowledge, service diagrams for repairing [product_name] are not available.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked for service diagrams to repair [product_name] PLC hardware, but another user indicated that such documentation is not available. The main UX observation is that users looking for hardware repair information cannot access these resources through official support channels, limiting their ability to perform self-maintenance.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect access to detailed service diagrams for [product_name] PLC hardware to enable self-repair.
